referenceFunction.generalComment: The dataset represents a non-integrated paper mill with a annual production of 368 kt and a total life time of 50 years.; UUID: d1374aef-296d-3c4f-ae87-34fa433f19c2
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the land-use, buildings (hall and multi-story) and streets within the mill area, machineries for pulp preparation and for paper and energy production as well as the dismanteling/disposal of the whole infrastructure (without the paper machine)

geography.text: Average land-use from European paper mills, valable for whole Europe
